functions.name: kamyu_sum
functions.description: Computes and returns the arithmetic sum of two 32-bit signed integers. Intended for straightforward integer addition; usable from both C and C++ (C linkage via extern "C"). No side effects or state.
requirements: Parameters a and b are 32-bit signed integers (type int).
The mathematical result a + b must be representable in type int; signed overflow or underflow is undefined behavior in C.
The function is pure with no external state; it can be called any number of times and is reentrant/thread-safe as it uses no shared state.
